origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends; its tool names, its generation settings with a dynamic thinking budget, the functionCall and functionResponse parts with the ids of the gateway), the first request of a session (model gemini-2.5-pro for the google vendor, claude-sonnet-4.5 for the anthropic vendor); the tool list is cut to six tools and the long texts are shortened. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
